dpdp_banner_text: Full compliance by May 13, 2027 (216 days). Consent Manager Framework (Rule 4) goes live Nov 13, 2026 — just 35 days away. Data Protection Board appointments still pending; consent manager registration portal expected before deadline.

funding_summary: The $870M+ in tracked legal tech funding signals an industry doubling down on AI-native compliance, due-diligence, and legal ops automation. Harvey’s $15.5B valuation anchors the market; new entrants like Xapien ($56M for AI due diligence), Comp AI ($34M for compliance automation), and Complaion (€13.5M for SME compliance) confirm that compliance-tech is the hottest sub-sector. For Team Counsel: (1) advisory demand as Indian enterprises adopt these tools, (2) fractional GC pipeline from GCCs — Eli Lilly, Costco, LPL Financial, HCA Healthcare all establishing Hyderabad centres without India legal heads, (3) partnership windows with well-funded platforms like Comp AI and SpotDraft that need India market expertise. The 35-day DPDP consent manager deadline creates immediate urgency for every data fiduciary in India.
